rationale: The prior plan's group_by parameter was incomplete, producing only the composite specialty+network_status grouping. To address all three feedback findings (missing network_status groups, missing provider_specialty groups, and missing in-network denial rate), group_comparison now includes all three grouping options: provider_specialty, network_status, and their composite. This generates separate metrics for specialty groups, network status groups (In-Network vs Out-of-Network), and the detailed specialty+network_status breakdown. All four requested metrics (volume, paid amount, denial and fraud rates) are computed over adjudicated claims with small-group flagging at 30 claims, following the retrieved skill on denial rate computation discipline. Top-10 provider ranking by claim count directly addresses the objective, and report includes numerator/denominator detail as required.
changes_summary: Expanded group_by parameter from ["provider_specialty+network_status"] to ["provider_specialty", "network_status", "provider_specialty+network_status"] to produce separate group comparisons for each grouping dimension independently. This provides the network_status breakdown (In-Network/Out-of-Network) and provider_specialty breakdown that the prior execution failed to generate, while retaining the composite analysis. Denominator (adjudicated_claims), all metrics, and remaining steps unchanged.
